What's New in v1.0.3

  • 📝 Description: Export and import your layouts, duplicate layouts with ease, plus improved shortcuts reliability and overall stability.
  • ✨ New: Export/Import – now you can export all your layouts and import them; you can share them with other users or keep them as a backup.
  • ✨ New: Delete all layouts – new button in Settings › Advanced; it can delete all your layouts if needed or if you want to completely replace your current layouts with newly imported ones. Previously, that button would reset all settings and layouts.
  • ✨ New: You can now duplicate your layouts in the sidebar. Right-click › Duplicate.
  • 🛠️ Fix: There was an issue where shortcuts wouldn't work after a system reboot. You had to manually start the app to make them work. Now it's fixed, and they work flawlessly.
  • 🛠️ Fix: Multiple internal bugs fixed that might've caused some inconvenience.
  • 📈 Improvements: Overall shortcuts handling has been improved.
  • 📈 Improvements: Minor internal improvements for stability and error handling.
